features.title: Open Jujutsu references from a chat message
features.summary: Inline code in a message becomes a link when it is an explicit JJ identity — a revision-shaped token, a repository bookmark, or a `jj:`-prefixed name — hovering it previews a bounded revision graph around it — its neighbourhood plus the working copy, main, main@origin and the default workspace, with separate Commit ID and Change ID labels — and clicking it opens the side panel on the Session repository, focused on that revision or comparing it with main/default along its history path. The `jj:` prefix is the writing convention Agents are told to use, and the reader sees the referenced revision's first-line description in the native session-reference chip style with its icon, truncated when long; the accessible label and hover tooltip retain the full title and reference. Visible links resolve titles lazily and fall back to the bare reference if a title is unavailable.
reach: expect text "Open Jujutsu refs from chat"
expect text "Compare with main/default and show history path"

configuration.constraints: Boolean; link explicit inline-code revision ids, repository bookmarks and `jj:`-prefixed names in chat.
One of focus or path; path compares against main/default and shows ancestry.

failureModes: Ordinary inline code and another thread's conversation are never rewritten.
A reference that is not in the loaded graph page falls back to the graph search.
Without a link owner (the plugin is not loaded) native inline code stays inert text.

features.title: Clean up idle JJ workspaces
features.summary: The repository menu's Clean up JJ workspaces dialog accepts 1-, 6-, and 24-hour presets or a custom whole-hour inactivity threshold, previews what qualifies, then starts a background removal job that survives closing the panel: a trail under the panel header reports scanning, each removed or kept workspace, the empty revisions it abandons, and keeps the last result until dismissed. Other JJ workspaces are manual-only and unchecked by default; checking them runs normal jj status to detect unsnapshotted changes, which it snapshots into the working-copy revision while preserving the files.
reach: fill textbox "Search projects or enter a folder path" "sample"
expect text "0 empty revisions will be abandoned."
failureModes: A custom inactivity threshold must be a positive whole number of hours.
A workspace with unlanded work, a busy Session or a queued integration is kept.
A second click on the same scope attaches to the job already running instead of queuing it twice.
A Host restart drops the trail with the job; what it already removed stays removed.
Other JJ workspaces are manual-only and opt-in; automatic cleanup never includes them.
A workspace with uncommitted changes, unverifiable state, unknown last-use time, or a nested JJ workspace stays.
If the Host cannot enumerate Sessions to verify secondary workspace activity, cleanup preview fails closed.
Normal jj status can snapshot unsnapshotted changes into the workspace working-copy revision while preserving their files.

features.title: Keep one repository per Jujutsu tab, thread and dock
features.summary: Each Jujutsu surface keeps its own repository, view, filters, selection and expanded rows. The page header's copy-plus button opens the repository on screen in another main tab through @dshfiles/main-tabs, named after that repository and renamed after whichever one the tab shows later; picking another tab restores its own state. A thread's right-panel Jujutsu page opens on that thread's project instead of the last repository picked anywhere, and the global dock keeps its own.
